test_title: PYST 49: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: CPWG is related to XTTI in a certain way. In the same way, NILC is related to IMIE. To which of the given options is OKZD related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b04ee1ca8eed94468de551a75e28f2a695e13769be882192242444447411966f.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, CPWG → XTTI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc54250cbc2b2567530854b530741c0aecde5fde7719d8fe22e61c2b709089dc.png] 

For, NILC → IMIE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8132826b2d2f06822e82caae900cc8fc3d329cd43e3d3de316f56db9a520ee3.png] 

Now, apply the same to OKZD:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95396d5323fd1b77460e6aba03ae9803632429abff591a1ed65c3646726bf6f7.png] 

So, OKZD → JOWF

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
